blocks.text: Store manager feedback notes, September 14

This is the working cut for LSH-MTG-2023-049 on September 14, 2023. Cole Brennan asked for a written bound after the current path (Pickup mail to luis@, clamp in API, no weekend SLA) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host conf.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on page Luis for every pickup email, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Pickup emails go to the store alias, not Luis. Negative qty stays clamped. Weekend packing is not in the SLA unless Luis signs it. I am not restating a hallway yes. page Luis for every pickup email is out because Luis is not the packer. Cole's alias is. Paging Luis trained everyone to ignore the alias. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at stores=4, emails_wk=64.2, weekend=0, clamp=0, hours=1.1, weeks=1, aliases=4, sla=0. Sibling tickets LSH-4955 and LSH-PRD-2023-026. I will not reopen page Luis for every pickup email in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (33): refuse on page Luis for every pickup email, lock is store alias, clamp, weekend out unless signed. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4955.
Weekend coverage is not implied because the site stays up. Someone has to pack.

What a skeptical user would try first on conf.lakeshore.internal: the path Cole Brennan actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on pickup.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
